queue_lifecycle.gate_rule: Inject interactive test packets only after 0x4026d4c8 equals 0x4192a9d0. The isolated proof used a conservative six-second delay after identity.

known_trig_and_encoder_examples.result: Fully transferred and consumed after live-queue activation, but no persistent framebuffer state change in the current page.

frame_export_note.observation: Unsynchronized polling can capture torn intermediate drawing states. Only stable post-event hashes are accepted as gate evidence.

conclusion: The stock OS 1.72 interactive path is proven end-to-end: native UART packet, UART8 RX request, eDMA channel 34, vector 154 ISR, byte parser, live UI queue, UI dispatcher, state handling, and persistent presented-framebuffer change.
